Proof in the paper: The MoS2 (002) peak at 2θ = 14.2° indicates a multilayered MoS2 structure over s-CoMo/G-IM [43]. In contrast, no multilayered MoS2 peaks at 2θ = 14.2° are detected in the XRD patterns of s-CoMo/G-HMBx, suggesting that the MoS2 nanoparticles on these catalysts are well-dispersed on graphene. No characteristic peaks of cobalt species were observed in the XRD patterns because of low cobalt loading on all the catalysts.
